Title: Existing Home Sales Collapse -8.4%
Summary: NAR reports Jan 2026 existing home sales fell 8.4% MoM to 3.91M SAAR — biggest monthly drop in 4 years, lowest level since Dec 2023. South region -9.0%, West -10.3%. Days on market jumped to 46 (from 39). Despite mortgage rates easing to 6.10%, sales still collapsed. Median price +0.9% YoY to $396,800. Inventory 3.7 months supply. First-time buyers only 31% (vs historic 40%). "Hotel California" extends to housing — easy to stay, hard to transact.
Diagnostic_Value: HIGH - Housing velocity collapse confirms consumer stress transmission; impairs bank collateral exit
